meta.name: playwright-skill
meta.description: Complete browser automation with Playwright. Auto-detects dev servers, writes clean test scripts to /tmp. Test pages, fill forms, take screenshots, check responsive design, validate UX, test login flows, check links, automate any browser task. Use when user wants to test websites, automate browser interactions, validate web functionality, or perform any browser-based testing.

copy.tagline: 自动测试网站页面与交互
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要验证网站功能或自动化浏览器操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tests for your web pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify website functionality or automate browser operations.

howto.what: Claude 会用 Playwright 自动操作浏览器:测试网页、填写表单、截图等。它会先检测本地开发服务器,把测试脚本写到 /tmp,再用可见浏览器运行并展示结果。
howto.when: 当你提出测试网站、自动化浏览器操作、验证网页功能等需求时触发,例如要求检查登录流程、响应式布局或页面截图。

say.text: 帮我测试这个网站在手机和电脑上的显示效果
say.note: 会检测本地服务,并跨设备尺寸截图对比

say.text: 检查登录流程,填邮箱密码后能否进入首页
say.note: 会自动化登录并验证跳转结果

say.text: 看看这个页面有没有失效的链接
say.note: 会遍历所有外链并报告状态

howto.what_en: Claude uses Playwright to run browser automation: test pages, fill forms, take screenshots, etc. It auto-detects dev servers, writes scripts to /tmp, runs them in a visible browser, and reports results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to test a website, automate browser interactions, or validate web functionality (e.g., checking login flow, responsive layout, or taking screenshots).

say_en.text: Help me test how this website looks on mobile and desktop.
say_en.note: It detects the local server and screenshots both sizes.

say_en.text: Check the login flow: can I enter email and password and reach the home page?
say_en.note: It will automate login and verify the redirect.

say_en.text: Check if this page has any broken links.
say_en.note: It will scan all external links and report their status.
